name: Citi Strata Premier® Card

tripDelay.notes: Coverage applies when common carrier is delayed 6+ hours or overnight. Cardholder and accompanying immediate family members covered.

tripCancellation.notes: Trip cancellation and trip interruption coverage up to $5,000 per person, $10,000 per trip when travel is purchased with the card.

lostBaggage.notes: Coverage for lost, stolen, or damaged baggage when travel is purchased with the card.

emergencyMedical.notes: No dedicated emergency medical evacuation benefit. Citi Strata Premier is a mid-tier travel card without emergency medical coverage.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary coverage. Decline the CDW at the rental counter. File with primary auto insurance first.

hotelCredit.notes: $100 annual hotel benefit: once per calendar year, enjoy $100 off a single hotel stay of $500 or more (excluding taxes and fees) when booked through CitiTravel.com. Benefit applied instantly at time of booking.

rewards.baseRate: 1x ThankYou® Points per $1 on all other purchases
rewards.travelRate: 10x on Hotels, Car Rentals, and Attractions booked on CitiTravel.com; 3x on air travel and other hotel purchases
otherBonusCategories: 3x at gas stations and EV charging stations

pointValue.transferPartners: Varies — often 0.015-0.02+ with airline partners like American Airlines, JetBlue, Singapore Airlines, Turkish Airlines

emergencyContacts.benefitsCenter: Refer to card benefit guide for claims
emergencyContacts.claimsCenter: Citi Benefits Center — see card documentation

travelPerks: $100 annual hotel benefit at CitiTravel.com (on $500+ stay)
3x points on flights, hotels, restaurants, supermarkets, gas stations
10x points on hotels/car rentals/attractions through CitiTravel.com
Trip cancellation/interruption up to $5,000 per person
Trip delay reimbursement after 6 hours ($500 coverage)
Transfer to 15+ airline partners (American Airlines, JetBlue, Singapore, etc.) at 1:1 ratio
bestFor: Everyday spenders who travel and want broad bonus categories with access to Citi ThankYou transfer partners at a $95 annual fee
